data.description: A list of Postman elements that match the search query and filters.

nextCursor.description: The pagination cursor that points to the next record in the results set.

searchMetaData.description: Pagination metadata for the search results.
searchMetaData.title: searchMetaData

method.description: The request's HTTP method. Returns only for requests.

type.description: The resource type variant, such as HTTP or gRPC. Returns only for requests.

description.description: A brief description of the resource, if available.

summary.description: A brief summary of the resource, if available. Returns only for workspaces and collections.

url.description: The request URL of the resource. Returns only for requests.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the resource. Returns only for workspaces and collections.

specificationId.description: The specification's ID. Returns only for specifications.

specificationType.description: The specification's type. Returns only for specifications.

specificationName.description: The specification's name. Returns only for specifications.

isPrivateNetworkEntity.description: Whether the resource is part of a private API network.

createdBy.description: The ID of the user who created the resource.

isGitConnected.description: If true, the resource is connected to Git. Returns only for workspaces, collections, requests, specifications, and flows.

searchRequestsCollectionData.description: Information about the collection containing the resource. Returns only for requests.
searchRequestsCollectionData.title: searchRequestsCollectionData

searchResourceLinksData.description: Information about the resource's hypermedia links.
searchResourceLinksData.title: searchResourceLinksData

href.description: The URL to access the resource through the Postman API.

searchResourceLinksSelfData.description: The link to the resource through the Postman API.
searchResourceLinksSelfData.title: searchResourceLinksSelfData

isVerified.description: If true, the organization is verified by Postman.

searchResourceOrganizationData.description: Information about the organization that published the resource. This returns a null value for the `user` publisher type.
searchResourceOrganizationData.title: searchResourceOrganizationData

searchResourceTeamData.description: Information about the team associated with the resource. This returns a null value for the `user` publisher type.
searchResourceTeamData.title: searchResourceTeamData

href.description: The URL to view the resource in the Postman web app.

searchResourceWebData.description: The link to view the resource in the Postman web app.
searchResourceWebData.title: searchResourceWebData

searchResourceWorkspacesData.description: Information about the workspace containing the resource.
searchResourceWorkspacesData.title: searchResourceWorkspacesData
